basic_info.description:
Nestled in one of San Francisco's most coveted neighborhoods, this beautifully renovated three-story home offers the perfect blend of classic charm and modern convenience. The upper floors feature 4 spacious
bedrooms, 2 bathrooms with indoor laundry. The lower level includes a separate one-bedroom in-law, ideal for guests or rental income potential.
Easy access to restaurants, parks and public transportation!
